item.text:
The welcome page now schedules a page-view event with Next.js’s [`after()` API](/workspace/app/page.tsx:7). The page is rendered dynamically so each request schedules its own event. The [analytics helper](/workspace/app/analytics.ts:1) sends a JSON POST and logs failures without delaying the response.

Set `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT` to your service’s POST URL; the setting is shown in [.env.example](/workspace/.env.example:1). No live service was specified, so external delivery still depends on that configuration.

Verification: `npm run build` passed. With a local analytics endpoint delayed by 2 seconds, the welcome response completed in 126 ms and the page-view event was received.
